schema_note: Layer 1 single-knee stair-assist simulation. Intent v1 is synthetic. Not EMG, not a human subject, and not a fall-prevention result. The 24 Nm PID limit is a safety parameter and is not a tuning knob.

human.note: Bounded synthetic knee torque. The tracker follows the synthetic trajectory and is clipped to torque_limit_nm.

load.assumption: Theoretical stair-support moment. A synthetic 70 kg body, not a measured person, places knee_weight_share of its weight on this knee. The moment arm is moment_arm_m*sin(flexion), zero when the knee is straight and moment_arm_m at 90 degrees. The load is a flexion moment. It is not an inverse-dynamics result from a gait lab.

strap.note: Spring-damper cuff between the human shank and the exoskeleton link. Interaction torque is this constraint torque.

assist_policy.source: Copied stair-assist parameters from PR #3 AssistPolicy usage (gain 0.65, limit 80 Nm, slew 350 Nm/s).

pid.algorithm: Same anti-windup recurrence as simulation/webots/controllers/joint_controller/joint_controller.cpp. The 24 Nm limit is a safety parameter. ki is 0 so a persistent gravity moment cannot wind the integrator into that limit.

metrics.comfort_basis: Design assumption only, not a comfort study: 15 Nm is 0.08 m cuff moment arm times 187.5 N strap force. Peaks at or above this value fail the interaction criterion.
